Learner notes for **PHY2405 (Experimental Methods in High Energy Physics)**. Each lecture week is a chapter under `lectures/`. Preview with `quarto preview` from this directory, or open `_site/index.html` after `quarto render`.

::: {.callout-note}
**About these notes.** Most of this course's lectures do not state clearly what they are trying to teach, so we recommend following these notes alongside the original materials at www.physics.utoronto.ca/~phy2405, not instead of them. The originals are also mostly in image form (scanned or handwritten pages and figures) rather than text.
:::
